_doc: 20 starter prompts for the W10 bigger multi-turn discriminability test (n=20, 8 turns each = 160 generations per construct). Includes the original 4 from W9 + 16 new ones spanning a wider range of topics where the 5 deployment-ready channels can produce visible differentiation: career, finances, relationships, team management, life decisions, learning, conflict.

starters.starter_prompt: I'm trying to decide what to do with my next 12 months. I have stable income, no urgent obligations, and three options on the table: stay in my current role and double down, take a sabbatical to travel, or quit and start something new. Help me think this through.
I just got £200,000 from a windfall. I'm 38, mortgage paid, no kids, decent salary. I want to think about what to do with it. Walk me through your view.
I run a team of 14 people. We've had a strong 18 months but the energy is flagging — some of the senior people seem bored. I want to think about how to restart momentum. Where would you start?

A close friend of mine is going through a hard time — they lost their job, their relationship is strained, and they're not sleeping well. I want to be useful to them but I'm not sure how. What's your view?
I've been offered a senior role at a competitor. 30% pay rise, more responsibility, but I'd be leaving a team I love and a company I helped build. Help me think through this.
I'm 45 and I've never really pursued anything risky in my career. I have savings, decent health, no major obligations. Should I do something bold now while I still can?
My adult son moved back home 3 months ago after a breakup. He's spiralling — drinking too much, not looking for work. I love him but I'm worried I'm enabling. What should I do?
Two of my direct reports are in conflict and it's affecting the team. They've both come to me individually with their version. I have a meeting with both tomorrow. How should I handle it?
I'm thinking of starting a podcast in my industry. It would take 8-10 hours a week. My wife is sceptical — she thinks I'll lose interest after 3 months like the last side project. Should I do it?

I have a 6-month sabbatical coming up. I could spend it learning Spanish in Mexico, doing a long bike trip across South America, or finally writing the book I've been thinking about for years. Help me decide.
My business partner of 8 years wants to take the company in a direction I think is wrong. Possibly catastrophically wrong. We have equal equity. How do I navigate this?

I'm in my mid-30s and considering whether to have children. My partner is more enthusiastic than me — I'm worried about losing the freedom and depth of focus that's defined my life so far. Walk me through how to think about this.
I just inherited my grandfather's old farmhouse in Wales. It's beautiful but needs £150k of work and it's a 4-hour drive from where I live. I could renovate, sell, or rent. What would you advise?
I lead a team of 8 and I have to let one of them go due to budget cuts. They've been with us 5 years and have a young family. Help me think about how to do this with dignity.

I'm 50 and I've been running marathons for 20 years. My knees are starting to complain. Doctor says I should switch to lower-impact training. Half of me agrees, half feels like I'm giving up part of my identity. Help me think through this.

An old mentor of mine is asking me for advice on a career pivot. He's 65, semi-retired, considering a non-executive director role at a mid-sized company. The pay isn't huge but the work would be interesting. What would you tell him to think about?

I've been single for 6 years and I'm starting to feel that's going to become permanent if I don't change something. I'm 42, successful, comfortable alone. Friends keep nudging me toward dating apps. What's your view?

My company is acquiring a smaller company and I'm being asked to lead the integration. It's a big career opportunity but also a likely 18-month grind with lots of difficult conversations. Should I take it?
I want to learn something new this year — something that would change how I think. Languages, philosophy, music theory, statistics — I have time for one. Help me pick.

My elderly father needs care he doesn't yet acknowledge needing. My siblings think we should hire help; I'm thinking he should move in with one of us. We're meeting next weekend to decide. What perspective should I bring?
